presentation.label: SLICE LOOP
presentation.summary: SLICE LOOP in the track menu fills an empty sound track with sixteen trigs, each locked to the next sixteenth of the sample.
presentation.overview: Slice Loop adds SLICE LOOP after SAVE TRACK in the track menu (FUNC + CHRO). On an empty sound track of 16 steps or more it sets the TRIG defaults to SYN off and SMP on, places trigs on steps 1 to 16, locks trig n's sample STA to 6(n-1) and END to 6n, then shows LOOP SLICED. It is meant for a one-bar loop padded so the bar fills 96/120 of the sample. On a track with any trig, a shorter track or the FX track it refuses and changes nothing. It is an elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0012-slice-loop, with his code unchanged.
highlights: One menu item slices a loop across sixteen steps.
Every write goes through stock's own setters.
Refuses, changing nothing, on a track that is not empty.
MrScruff's rytm-mods code, unchanged, linked by the elemod core.
usage: Use a build containing Slice Loop. Select an empty sound track and press FUNC + CHRO: SLICE LOOP is the last item.
Choose it: the screen shows LOOP SLICED, and steps 1 to 16 have trigs with STA/END locks 0/6, 6/12 up to 90/96.
Choose it again on the same track: TRACK NOT EMPTY, and nothing changes. On the FX track it shows ONLY ON SOUND TRACKS.

access.location: Track menu (FUNC + CHRO), after SAVE TRACK.
steps: Press FUNC + CHRO and choose SLICE LOOP.

controls.name: Track menu > SLICE LOOP
controls.doc: On an empty sound track of 16 steps or more: SYN off, SMP on, trigs on steps 1 to 16 with STA 6(n-1) and END 6n locks.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
Only on an empty sound track of at least 16 steps: any trig, lock trigs included, makes it refuse.
The slices are fixed at sixteen equal parts of 96/120 of the sample.

load.display: None in the audio path: runs when the track menu opens and when SLICE LOOP is chosen
load.conditions: Static: the site adds one menu item when the track menu is built; the action runs once when chosen. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: Iced-Cream reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, slice-loop 1.0 passed its test (on an empty sound track SLICE LOOP shows LOOP SLICED and places 16 trigs; choosing it again shows TRACK NOT EMPTY) in R8T2 (2026-10-18), and its own test again with core-ar2 0.3 and all eleven rytm2_mods ports in C3A4 (2026-10-20). On SXH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 with the other five Modwerk 1.74 submissions, 2026-10-24) SLICE LOOP showed LOOP SLICED and then TRACK NOT EMPTY, and a four-minute play showed no freeze or dropout. Alone on SLH4 (released core-ar2 0.3 and this module only, 2026-10-25) SLICE LOOP showed LOOP SLICED and then TRACK NOT EMPTY without changing the pattern again.
limitations: Tested builds: C3A4, .syx 04d987ced36850eef5eb5cd1215d411edf621a5af94f980525ab561c9108f951; R8T2, .syx 94c8b8c4f3f537132b7ee689ad1221591186f14dc605a420cdefe3df804e3c39. Firmware was not read back from the device.

SXH4 (the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-24/25, .syx e4d01a6aec250bd2af7743c9f8b0e9c560d805b52564932dddc41d872e1c5000) also carried a remote-control test layer that shares no site with core or the modules. SLH4 (alone with the released core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-25, .syx 10ef52bfdda5f24f1d0adf0f22055ff6fe4cc7acf711d9275d7943369205c95e) carried the same test layer.

tests.summary: Hardware: slice-loop 1.0's test passes on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74 (R8T2 with core-ar2 0.1, 2026-10-18; C3A4 with core-ar2 0.3, 2026-10-20). Modwerk's source build gives a main OS byte-identical to elekloader's build of the rytm2_mods v1.2 release. In rytm-emu, SLICE LOOP on BD places trigs locked 6/12 on step 2 and 90/96 on step 16, and a second try shows TRACK NOT EMPTY; stock's track menu ends at SAVE TRACK.
